BRICS Theatre Festival Begins in Delhi with 9 Nations

The BRICS Theatre Festival commenced in Delhi on October 12, featuring theatre traditions from nine participating nations. The three-day event includes artists and theatre groups from India, Thailand, Indonesia, Russia, Vietnam, Iran, South Africa, Kazakhstan, and Ethiopia. Over 100 artists are expected to participate, offering a platform for performers and theatre professionals.
